text:
anna_docs: quick heads-up 1 opened a tiny PR to consolidate a few recurring Optimize toolkit docs items: quant_profile alias table, a short migration checklist, and two SDK snippets (dialog vs batch). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3702 

devbot: PR #3702 opened by anna_docs  labels: docs,optkit,needs-review

kevin_eng: skimmed. Are we changing runtime defaults? want to avoid any silent behavior change for customers.

anna_docs: no runtime change. docs-only. added a clear callout at top: "No runtime behavior changes; aliases are documented for migration convenience." and a tiny sed helper for teams who want to rename config keys: `sed -i "s/quant_profile:\s*q8_0/q8_0_alias/g" **/*.yaml`

sanjay_opt: good. also suggest a short note about KV prefetch: it helps throughput for long sequences but can increase first-token latency for streaming/short-turn use cases. we should show `batch_size=1, prefetch_kv=False` for dialog snippets.

anna_docs: added two labeled snippets under "Quick snippets" and a one-line heuristic under "When to disable KV prefetch": "Disable for short-turn dialog (seq < 48) to keep p50 low." snippets: `# latency-minded
from redwood import OptimizeClient
c = OptimizeClient()
c.configure(batch_size=1, prefetch_kv=False, quant_profile='q8_alias')
# throughput-minded
c.configure(batch_size=64, prefetch_kv=True, quant_profile='q8_alias')`

emily_pm: small product ask: step 3 links to Console overview  can you point it to /console/telemetry and call out that rollouts respect aliases? left an inline suggestion.

devbot: staging deploy started for refs/heads/docs/pr-3702  preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optkit/migration

devbot: CI: docs-lint PASS, link-check FAIL (1 Console URL)

anna_docs: fixed Console link to /console/telemetry, rebased and pushed. pasted brief smoke numbers for quick review: `[smoke] latency seq=16 p50=33ms tokens/s=145` and `[smoke] throughput seq=256 p50=120ms tokens/s=510`.

kevin_eng: LGTM from eng after nit: prefer "alias mapping" wording in the table header.

emily_pm: LGTM from product once CI green and add a one-line release-note.

devbot: CI: link-check PASS, other checks PASS

anna_docs: merging now. will add a release-note bullet and ping #support to watch for any migration questions in the next 48h. :tada:
